intro.title: What could your project cost?
intro.sub: Answer 3 quick questions. We point you to the right service, with real prices and how we calculate them.

biz.title: What stage is your business at?
biz.why: It helps us understand which kind of partnership makes most sense for you.

startup.label: New business (startup)
startup.desc: You are launching something new: validating an idea, building an MVP or scaling from zero.

est.label: Established business
est.desc: You already operate, with customers, revenue or teams, and want software to support the business.

funding.title: Do you have funding for the product?
funding.why: It shapes the pace, the team size and whether an equity partnership makes sense.

yes.label: Yes
yes.desc: You have raised capital or have a dedicated product budget.

no.label: Not yet
no.desc: You are bootstrapping or still raising.

techTeam.title: Do you have an in-house tech team?
techTeam.why: So we know whether to join your team or take on the whole technical side.

yes.label: Yes
yes.desc: You have Software Developers or a tech lead.

goalStartup.title: What is your main goal?
goalStartup.why: Pick the closest option. You can always change it later.

mvp.label: Build an MVP
mvp.desc: A first working version to validate with real users.

team.label: Build a tech team
team.desc: A dedicated team that owns the product long term.

support.label: Technical support
support.desc: Scoped help: integrations, bugs, scripts or maintenance.

unsure.label: Not sure, help me decide
unsure.desc: We recommend based on your previous answers.

goalEst.title: What is your main goal?
goalEst.why: Pick the closest option. You can always change it later.

new.label: Build a new product
new.desc: SaaS platform, client portal, internal tool or app.

modern.label: Modernise a legacy app
modern.desc: Improve, refactor or migrate without a risky rewrite.

aug.label: Augment the team (outsourcing)
aug.desc: More people on your roadmap and processes.

support.label: Technical support
support.desc: Scoped help: integrations, bugs, scripts or maintenance.

unsure.label: Not sure, help me decide
unsure.desc: We recommend based on your previous answers.

result.titleMany: Based on your answers, we suggest {n} paths.
result.titleOne: Based on your answers, this is the right path.
result.how: See the team and hourly rates
result.nextHint: Estimates are indicative. A short conversation lets us confirm scope and give you a closed proposal.

V.name: Betacode Ventures
V.desc: Technical co-founder partnership, from validation to launch and scale.
V.why: You do not pay for development: we invest our team in exchange for equity.
V.whyUnfunded: A good fit while you are not yet funded.
V.whyOther: You get a tech partner with as much at stake as you.
V.note: The model is adapted to your stage and product.

E.name: Self-managed tech teams
E.desc: A dedicated team owns product delivery: planning, development and launch.
E.why: No freelancers to manage: the team handles delivery end to end.
E.whyNoTeam: Works as your tech department, without hiring in-house.
E.whyOther: You choose the team size to match the scope.
E.note: Ranges for our usual teams. The final price depends on scope.

R.name: Team augmentation
R.desc: Hourly developers and product owners, integrated into your team and processes.
R.why: You only pay for the hours you need and adjust capacity at any time.
R.whyTeam: Builds on the tech team and processes you already have.
R.whyNoTeam: It can later grow into an in-house team.
R.note: You only pay for hours worked.

F.name: Training
F.desc: Sessions on languages, frameworks and best practices, one-to-one or for groups.
why: Your team learns new technologies from people who use them daily.
It can be combined with another service.
F.note: Programme tailored to your team level.

S.name: Support
S.desc: Integrations, bug fixes, scripts and maintenance on existing systems.
why: Scoped work with no long-term team commitment.
Ideal for something you already have that needs fixing.
